relationships.subject: Ketoprofen
relationships.evidence_quote: Pop‐PK/PD modeling of PGE2 gave an ISF IC50 of 0.08 μg/ml (estimated 1.2 μg/ml in plasma) for S‐(+)‐ketoprofen and an ED50 of 5.83 mg/kg.

relationships.subject: Flunixin
relationships.evidence_quote: Pop‐PK/PD modeling of cortisol gave an IC50 of 0.06 μg/ml and an ED50 of 0.51 mg/kg for flunixin.

relationships.subject: Prostaglandins
relationships.evidence_quote: Prostaglandins contribute to pain signaling by activating and sensitizing nociceptors

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: The COX‐2 isoform is inducible and upregulated by tissue damage and inflammatory stimuli, increasing production of prostaglandins

key_findings: First IC50 for PGE2 reduction by an NSAID in pigs: S-(+)-ketoprofen plasma IC50 1.2 ug/ml (ED50 5.83 mg/kg).
At label doses, flunixin gave 81% of maximal cortisol response vs 34-41% for ketoprofen, so flunixin may be best for castration pain.
